column3: Close to the Greek; BSB follows the critical text with “join me in suffering.”
BSB renders “no one serving as a soldier entangles himself” as “a soldier refrains from entangling himself” and “the affairs of life” as “civilian affairs.”
BSB renders “lawfully” as “according to the rules.”
BSB follows the critical text with “will give”; the Textus Receptus reads “may … give.”
BSB renders “has not been bound” as “cannot be chained.”
BSB follows the critical text with “before God”; the Textus Receptus has “before the Lord.” “The believers” is added.
BSB starts a new sentence with “They say.”
BSB follows the critical text with “the name of the Lord”; the Textus Receptus has “of Christ.”
BSB renders “unto dishonor” as “for common use.”
BSB starts with “He must” and adds “in the hope that.”
